## Behavior
Admit a Git reference when its declared 40-hex commit resolves exactly to a commit object in the declared canonical repository, even if that commit is on a side branch and is not an ancestor of current `HEAD`. Admission must still verify the exact repository, commit, path, tree entry type/mode, blob OID, blob SHA-256, clean tracked worktree path, and clean identity coordinates. Reserved generated IDs/paths (including pending future outputs) and unresolvable/foreign commits remain failures.

## Owner
`src/recorder/admit.ts::verifyGitReference` owns commit/object/path/blob/hash/worktree admission. The regression belongs in `test/recorder-admission.test.ts`; checked-in runtime output is regenerated at `dist/recorder/admit.js`. No Soul/schema/README change is warranted because this is an admission-runtime invariant already represented by existing declarations and documentation.

## Red
Replace the current side-branch rejection matrix cell with an end-to-end positive exact-reference regression using the existing side-branch fixture. Assert Recorder succeeds, spawns exactly once, promotes the docket, and records the side commit/path/blob OID/SHA-256 exactly while leaving repository `HEAD` and index/worktree state unchanged. Remove the orphan/non-HEAD rejection expectation as well, because after removing the ancestry rule a resolvable orphan commit cannot lawfully remain a negative case. Keep the existing malformed, short, all-zero, foreign/unresolvable, path/blob/hash, dirty/deleted/untracked, and reserved generated/future-output counterexamples unchanged.

## Green
Delete only the `git merge-base --is-ancestor <commit> HEAD` check and its `not reachable from HEAD` error from `verifyGitReference`. Retain exact `rev-parse --verify <40hex>^{commit}` resolution and every subsequent tree/blob/hash/worktree/identity check. Rebuild Recorder output, then run the focused admission test (`node --import tsx --test test/recorder-admission.test.ts`), `npm run typecheck`, and the full `npm test`; inspect the final diff/status to confirm no unrelated changes.

## Scope / commit / Receipt
Expected files: `src/recorder/admit.ts`, `test/recorder-admission.test.ts`, and generated `dist/recorder/admit.js` only. Do not inspect sessions and do not alter acceptance criteria, schemas, docs, Souls, or unrelated admission behavior. Apply should create exactly one forward commit, proposed title `fix(recorder): admit exact side-branch references`, with a body recording the removed ancestry root cause and preserved checks. The apply Receipt should report changed files, focused/typecheck/full-test results, commit SHA, and clean/authorized worktree evidence.
